supporting_observations.claim: At 13:39:44–13:39:59 UTC, WS-ACOLE-01 generated proxy requests for Zoom and Google Docs content under amy.cole's browser identity.
At 13:40:21 UTC, WS-ACOLE-01 made a successful proxy tunnel request to ctldl.windowsupdate.com with a Microsoft-CryptoAPI user agent.
The supplied records do not establish that a PowerShell process ran at the reported time, nor do the nearby web and proxy events establish what caused the reported window to appear.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied records around the reported time contain network/proxy activity but no PowerShell process-creation event, command line, script-block content, or process ancestry. The available evidence therefore cannot confirm or exclude a brief PowerShell window.
The proxy records show destinations and some browser or client user-agent details, but do not identify the local process responsible for the reported window.
claims_not_established: Whether PowerShell actually launched on WS-ACOLE-01 around 13:40 UTC.
If it launched, which account or process started it, what command or script ran, and whether the activity was authorized.
Whether the reported window was related to nearby browser or Windows Update activity.
additional_evidence_needed: Endpoint process and EDR telemetry for WS-ACOLE-01 covering at least 13:20–14:20 UTC, including PowerShell executable launches, parent-child process relationships, command lines, and user/session context.
PowerShell Operational logs, including script-block and module logging if enabled, plus relevant Windows process-creation and security audit events.
Available endpoint artifacts for the interval, such as console/window history, Prefetch, and relevant application or task logs, to corroborate whether PowerShell ran and identify its origin.
unrelated_findings: DropboxUpdate traffic to desktop.dropbox.com was observed from WS-ACOLE-01; Dropbox is not listed among approved services. This is separate from the reported PowerShell activity. (T264-00099)
Google Docs traffic from WS-ACOLE-01 was observed; Google Docs is not listed among approved services. This is separate from the reported PowerShell activity. (T264-00146, T264-00148)

Kerberos activity sourced from WS-ACOLE-01's address identified sean.byrne, followed by network logons for that account on WS-SBYRNE-01. The supplied records do not explain why the administrator account was involved from this workstation; review separately. (T264-00011, T264-00015, T264-00059, T264-00063)

At 13:55 UTC, WS-ACOLE-01 resolved afemode.orchard.local and made an unsuccessful TCP connection attempt to an internal host on port 1433. This is outside the alerted activity and should be reviewed separately. (T264-00283, T264-00295)

At 14:16 UTC, amy.cole authenticated to WS-RDIAZ-01 with WS-SBYRNE-01 recorded as the workstation name. This is outside the reported PowerShell time and should be reviewed separately. (T264-00411, T264-00412, T264-00413)
